summary.text: Bob Fehrenbacher is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 11, which covers Wood County.
He chairs the Energy and Manufacturing committee and is a retired manufacturing executive.

paragraphs.text: Fehrenbacher was born on November 25, 1957, and his page lists a B.S. in chemical engineering from the University of Texas at Austin.
It names his spouse as Annette and his children as Susan, Matt and Sarah.

His affiliations include the Wood County Development Authority, the West Virginia Manufacturers Association, the Wood County Farm Bureau and the Parkersburg Rotary, and he is a former board chair of the United Way Alliance of the Mid-Ohio Valley.

His committee assignments are Energy and Manufacturing (chair), Appropriations, Banking and Insurance, Energy and Public Works, and Finance, and he is vice chair of the interim Rule-Making Review Committee.
